title: Sand
description: A tray of fine sand dyed in the colours of a record sleeve, under a low sun. Drag the rake through it and four tines plough furrows, banking the coloured grains into ridges that slump to their angle of repose; hold still and sand from the next sleeve pours from your hand.
intent: Factory round 1. Material: sand. Verb: rake. A cover you can plough and re-pour.
